Name: contains
Meaning: Framework contains Requirements
Rule: Every Requirement has exactly one FrameworkID including a reviewed source version

Name: mapped_to
Meaning: Requirement coverage mapping to Control
Rule: Retain mapping type rationale coverage provenance and endpoint revisions; mapping is not satisfaction

Name: realized_by
Meaning: Reusable Control has scoped realizations
Rule: Each Control Implementation has one ControlID

Name: originates
Meaning: Case introduces or contributes to a Driver
Rule: Driver.CaseID identifies origin; additional Cases do not duplicate the Driver

Name: supports
Meaning: Governed Evidence supports a typed subject
Rule: Existing RelatedObjectType/ID is a primary convenience link; additional typed links reuse Evidence

Name: has_context
Meaning: Case context includes attributable statements
Rule: Preserve classification validation sources and original narrative

Name: applicability
Meaning: Scoped applicability of a Framework Requirement
Rule: Retain scope decision basis certainty source revisions rationale and approval; missing mapping remains unresolved

Name: seeks_outcome
Meaning: Driver seeks a reusable outcome
Rule: Voluntary target does not imply external mandate

Name: advances
Meaning: Guidance supports an objective
Rule: Explain conditions and limitations

Name: recommends
Meaning: Guidance recommends a safeguard
Rule: Source strength remains separate from tenant applicability

Name: realizes
Meaning: Option describes a possible Control realization
Rule: Does not create a Control Implementation or prove coverage

Name: alternative_to
Meaning: Alternative approach in a stated context
Rule: Symmetric option comparison; no equivalence of compliance inferred

Name: conflicts_with
Meaning: Sourced guidance conflict
Rule: Symmetric; retain context disagreement and both sources

Name: agrees_with
Meaning: Corroborating guidance
Rule: Symmetric; agreement does not establish applicability or authority

Name: issues
Meaning: Party acts as issuer or authority
Rule: Source-backed role; unresolved issuer text does not force party creation

Name: adopts
Meaning: Organization adopts a pinned definition within scope
Rule: Retain approval Evidence effective time target and optional binding; never change reusable definition

Name: evaluates
Meaning: Assessment Result evaluates a scoped subject
Rule: Manual V1 states Satisfied Partial Unsatisfied Not Assessed; attributable approved result

Name: addresses
Meaning: Remediation addresses a Finding
Rule: Acceptance changes Planned Posture only; reassessment changes Current Posture

Name: uses_option
Meaning: Scoped implementation uses a pinned option
Rule: Local deviations and Evidence retained; selecting option is not verification

Name: mitigates
Meaning: Control contributes to treating a tenant Risk
Rule: Effectiveness and residual risk require scope Evidence and decision history
